Despite the empirical success of GNNs, there has been relatively little work that mathematically studies their properties. An exception to this is the work of Scarselli et al. Network (GIN) is theoretically motivated, simple yet powerful.

In this paper we introduce deep learning (unsupervised
feature learning) [2] techniques, which have proven success-ful in natural language processing, into network analysis for the first time. We develop an algorithm ( DeepWalk) that learns social representations of a graph’s vertices, by modeling a stream of short random walks. These latent representations encode social relations in a continuous vector space with a relatively small number of dimensions. DeepWalk generalizes neural language models to process a
special language composed of a set of randomly-generated
walks. These neural language models have been used to
capture the semantic and syntactic structure of human language [6], and even logical analogies [28]. DeepWalk takes a graph as input and produces a latent representation as an output. correspond to clusters found through modularity maximiza-tion in the input graph (1a) (shown as vertex colors). To demonstrate DeepWalk’s potential in real world sce- narios, we evaluate its performance on challenging multi-label network classification problems in large heterogeneous graphs. In the relational classification problem, the links between feature vectors violate the traditional i.i.d. assumption.

question: node2vec 中 p 和 q 的作用是什么？
answer:
在 node2vec 中，\(p\) 和 \(q\) 通过偏置项 \(\alpha_{pq}(t,x)\) 调节随机游走的未归一化转移概率  
\(\pi_{vx}=\alpha_{pq}(t,x)\cdot w_{vx}\)，其中 \(d_{tx}\) 是上一节点 \(t\) 与候选下一节点 \(x\) 的最短路径距离，且 \(d_{tx}\in\{0,1,2\}\)；因此 \(p\)、\(q\) 足以引导游走 [node2vec_2016]。

- \(p\) 是 return parameter：当 \(d_{tx}=0\) 时 \(\alpha=1/p\)，控制立即重访节点的可能性。\(p\) 高（\(>\max(q,1)\)）会降低两步内再次采样已访问节点的概率，鼓励适度探索并避免 2-hop 冗余；\(p\) 低（\(<\min(q,1)\)）会使游走回退一步，保持局部、靠近起始节点 \(u\) [node2vec_2016]。
- \(q\) 是 in-out parameter：当 \(d_{tx}=2\) 时 \(\alpha=1/q\)，使搜索能区分“向内”和“向外”节点；低 \(q\) 鼓励向外探索 [node2vec_2016]。
- 当 \(d_{tx}=1\) 时 \(\alpha=1\)，不由 \(p\) 或 \(q\) 调节 [node2vec_2016]。

总体上，\(p\) 和 \(q\) 控制游走探索并离开起始节点邻域的速率，使搜索近似在 BFS 与 DFS 之间插值，从而反映对不同节点等价性（如同质性或结构等价）的偏好 [node2vec_2016]。例如在 Les Misérables 网络上，\(p=1,q=0.5\) 时发现社区/同质性，\(p=1,q=2\) 时发现结构角色/结构等价 [node2vec_2016]。默认值为 \(p=q=1\) [node2vec_2016]。在 BlogCatalog 上，性能随 \(p\) 和 \(q\) 降低而改善；低 \(q\) 鼓励向外探索，低 \(p\) 使游走不过度远离起始节点 [node2vec_2016]。

The objective in Eq. 2 is independent of any downstream task and the flexibility in exploration offered by node2vec lends the learned feature representations to a wide variety of network analysis settings discussed below. 4.1 Case Study: Les Misérables network
In Section 3.1 we observed that BFS and DFS strategies represent extreme ends on the spectrum of embedding nodes based on the principles of homophily (i.e., network communities) and structural equivalence ( i.e., structural roles of nodes). We now aim to empirically demonstrate this fact and show that node2vec in fact can discover embeddings that obey both principles. We use a network where nodes correspond to characters in the novel Les Misérables [13] and edges connect coappearing characters. The network has 77 nodes and 254 edges. We set d = 16
and run node2vec to learn feature representation for every node in the network. The feature representations are clustered using k-means. We then visualize the original network in two dimensions with nodes now assigned colors based on their clusters. Figure 3(top) shows the example when we set p = 1,q = 0.5. Notice how regions of the network (i.e., network communities) are colored using the same color. In this setting node2vec discov-ers clusters/communities of characters that frequently interact with each other in the major sub-plots of the novel. Since the edges between characters are based on coappearances, we can conclude this characterization closely relates with homophily. In order to discover which nodes have the same structural roles we use the same network but setp = 1,q = 2, use node2vec to get node features and then cluster the nodes based on the obtained features.

Experimental results. The node feature representations are input to a one-vs-rest logistic regression classifier with L2 regularization. The train and test data is split equally over 10 random instances. We use the Macro-F1 scores for comparing performance in Table 2 and the relative performance gain is over the closest benchmark. The trends are similar for Micro-F1 and accuracy and are not shown. From the results, it is evident we can see how the added flexibility in exploring neighborhoods allows node2vec to outperform the other benchmark algorithms. In BlogCatalog, we can discover the right mix of homophily and structural equivalence by setting parametersp andq to low values, giving us 22.3% gain over Deep-
Walk and 229.2% gain over LINE in Macro-F1 scores. question: DeepWalk 与 Skip-gram 有什么关系？
answer:
根据给定证据，DeepWalk 与 Skip-gram 是“使用/泛化”关系：

- 证据明确给出：DeepWalk 使用 Skip-gram 模型 [sgc_2019]。
- DeepWalk 将自然语言处理中的无监督特征学习/神经语言模型引入图分析，把随机游走序列类比为“句子”，把节点类比为“词”，从而把语言建模从词序列泛化到图上的随机游走序列 [deepwalk_2014]。
- 因此，DeepWalk 的核心机制可理解为：用截断随机游走生成节点序列，再用 Skip-gram 类语言模型在序列中学习节点共现，得到低维连续向量表示；这些表示编码邻域相似性和社区成员关系 [deepwalk_2014]。
- 相关证据还表明，GraphSAGE 论文复现 DeepWalk 时使用了 TensorFlow word2vec tutorial 中的向量初始化等设置，并指出 DeepWalk 等价于 node2vec 在 \(p=q=1\) 时的模型 [graphsage_2017]。

但给定证据并未具体说明 DeepWalk 所用 Skip-gram 的窗口大小、负采样或目标函数细节。

question: Cluster-GCN 与大图训练可扩展性是什么关系？
answer:
Cluster-GCN 是一种面向大规模 GCN 训练可扩展性的算法：它通过利用图聚类结构来设计 SGD mini-batch，从而缓解大图训练中的内存与计算瓶颈，并扩大可训练的图规模和网络深度 [cluster_gcn_2019]。

具体关系体现在：

- 大规模 GCN 训练原本很困难：现有 SGD 算法要么计算成本随 GCN 层数指数增长，要么需要在内存中保存整图和每个节点的嵌入 [cluster_gcn_2019]。
- Cluster-GCN 每一步采样与图聚类算法识别出的稠密子图相关联的节点块，并把邻域搜索限制在该子图内；这种策略显著改善内存和计算效率，同时能达到与先前算法相当的测试精度 [cluster_gcn_2019]。
- 在可扩展性测试中，作者构建了 Amazon2M：2,000,000 节点、61,000,000 边，比此前最大公开数据集 Reddit 大 5 倍以上 [cluster_gcn_2019]。
- 在该数据上训练 3 层 GCN 时，Cluster-GCN 比当时最先进的 VR-GCN 更快（1523 秒 vs 1961 秒），且内存使用更少（2.2GB vs 11.2GB）[cluster_gcn_2019]。
- 在该数据上训练 4 层 GCN 时，Cluster-GCN 可在约 36 分钟完成，而所有现有 GCN 训练算法都因 out-of-memory 问题失败 [cluster_gcn_2019]。
- 内存方面，Cluster-GCN 只需存储当前 batch 内的节点嵌入，复杂度为 O(bFL)，显著优于 VR-GCN 和全梯度下降，并略优于其他 SGD 方法；计算方面，每 epoch 时间成本与梯度下降相同，且快于邻域搜索方法 [cluster_gcn_2019]。
- Cluster-GCN 还允许训练更深的 GCN 而不带来过多时间和内存开销，从而提升预测精度；例如 5 层 Cluster-GCN 在 PPI 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 测试 F1 99.36 [cluster_gcn_2019]。

因此，Cluster-GCN 与大图训练可扩展性的关系是：它通过聚类式分批和限制子图内邻域搜索，直接提升大规模、深层 GCN 训练的内存、计算和规模可扩展性，并在大图数据上验证了相对优势 [cluster_gcn_2019]。

Graph convolutional network (GCN) has been successfully applied to many graph-based applications; however, training a large-scale
GCN remains challenging. Current SGD-based algorithms suffer from either a high computational cost that exponentially grows with number of GCN layers, or a large space requirement for keep-ing the entire graph and the embedding of each node in memory. In this paper, we propose Cluster-GCN, a novel GCN algorithm that is suitable for SGD-based training by exploiting the graph clustering structure. Cluster-GCN works as the following: at each step, it samples a block of nodes that associate with a dense subgraph identified by a graph clustering algorithm, and restricts the neighborhood search within this subgraph. This simple but effective strategy leads to significantly improved memory and computational efficiency while being able to achieve comparable test accuracy with previous algorithms. To test the scalability of our algorithm, we create a new Amazon2M data with 2 million nodes and 61 million edges which is more than 5 times larger than the previous largest publicly available dataset (Reddit). For training a 3-layer GCN on this data,
Cluster-GCN is faster than the previous state-of-the-art VR-GCN
(1523 seconds vs 1961 seconds) and using much less memory (2.2GB vs 11.2GB). Furthermore, for training 4 layer GCN on this data, our algorithm can finish in around 36 minutes while all the existing
GCN training algorithms fail to train due to the out-of-memory issue.

In this paper, we propose a novel GCN training algorithm by
exploiting the graph clustering structure. We find that the efficiency of a mini-batch algorithm can be characterized by the notion of “embedding utilization”, which is proportional to the number of links between nodes in one batch or within-batch links. This finding mo-tivates us to design the batches using graph clustering algorithms that aims to construct partitions of nodes so that there are more graph links between nodes in the same partition than nodes in different partitions. Based on the graph clustering idea, we proposed
Cluster-GCN, an algorithm to design the batches based on efficient graph clustering algorithms (e.g., METIS [ 8]). We take this idea further by proposing a stochastic multi-clustering framework to improve the convergence of Cluster-GCN. Our strategy leads to huge memory and computational benefits. In terms of memory, we only need to store the node embeddings within the current batch, which is O(bF L) with the batch size b. This is significantly better than
VR-GCN and full gradient decent, and slightly better than other
SGD-based approaches. In terms of computational complexity, our algorithm achieves the same time cost per epoch with gradient descent and is much faster than neighborhood searching approaches. In terms of the convergence speed, our algorithm is competitive with other SGD-based approaches.

question: GCN 和 GAT 在邻居权重分配上有什么区别？
answer:
依据给定证据，GCN 与 GAT 在邻居权重分配上的核心区别是：**GAT 能通过注意力机制对同一邻域内的不同邻居分配不同权重；GCN-like 聚合在对照实验中被视为不具备这种逐邻居差异化权重的方案。**

具体支持如下：

- GAT 论文为评估注意力机制，构建了相同架构的常数注意力模型 Const-GAT，并将其与 **GCN-like aggregation scheme** 对比 [gat_2018]。这说明 GAT 的关键机制是让邻居权重可差异化，而 GCN-like 聚合被作为非差异化/常数注意力的对照 [gat_2018]。
- 作者明确指出，GAT 能够“给同一邻域中的不同节点分配不同权重”，并称这一点很重要 [gat_2018]。
- 实验上，GAT 在 PPI 上比 Const-GAT 提升 3.9%，作者称这直接证明“能够给不同邻居分配不同权重”的重要性 [gat_2018]；在 Cora 和 Citeseer 上，GAT 分别比 GCN 提升 1.5% 和 1.6%，作者认为这暗示给同一邻域节点分配不同权重可能有益 [gat_2018]。
- GAT 与 GCN 之间也被标注为 RELATED_TO 关系 [gat_2018]。

因此，按证据可概括为：**GAT 的邻居权重可由注意力机制差异化分配；GCN-like 聚合在对比中对应不进行这种逐邻居差异化加权的方案。**  
但给定证据没有给出 GCN 邻居权重的显式计算公式或具体归一化方式，因此这部分细节证据不足。

question: GraphSAGE 和 GIN 的聚合设计关注点有什么不同？
answer:
依据给定证据，两者的聚合设计关注点不同：

- **GraphSAGE 关注多种邻域聚合器的可替换性与实证比较**：它比较了不同 aggregator functions（mean、GCN、LSTM、pooling），并在 K=2、S1=25、S2=10 的邻域采样设置下评估；实验发现 LSTM- 和 pooling-based aggregators 相比 mean-/GCN-based aggregators 有显著增益，尽管 LSTM 本是面向序列数据而非无序集合设计的。[graphsage_2017]
- **GraphSAGE 因此也关注在归纳/跨图设定下，聚合器对无序邻域集合的处理效果**：其变体被用于节点分类和跨图泛化任务，且不同聚合器表现差异明显。[graphsage_2017]

- **GIN 关注 sum 聚合与 MLP 的组合（Sum–MLP）对图结构的捕捉能力**：GINs（Sum–MLP）在 9 个数据集上优于或匹敌 less powerful GNN variants，并在社会网络数据集上表现突出。[gin_2019]
- **GIN 的证据明确对比 sum 与 mean 聚合**：sum-aggregation GNNs 能准确捕捉图结构，在 Reddit 上即使所有节点共享相同标量节点特征也显著优于其他模型；mean-aggregation GNNs 则无法捕捉无标签图结构，甚至不比随机猜测好，即使提供节点度数也远差于 sum-based GNNs。[gin_2019]
- **GIN 还关注聚合设计的简洁性与泛化**：GIN-0 比 GIN-ϵ 略但一致地更好，二者拟合训练数据相当，GIN-0 泛化更好可能归因于其更简单。[gin_2019]

概括：就给定证据而言，GraphSAGE 的聚合设计关注点是**比较多种聚合器并在归纳式邻域采样下选择有效方案**；GIN 的聚合设计关注点是**采用 Sum–MLP 并强调 sum 聚合相对 mean 聚合在捕捉图结构/表达力上的优势**。[graphsage_2017][gin_2019] 更深入的理论目标（如单射性、同构区分）在给定证据中未展开，证据不足。

证据中并未一般性地定义“普通节点级 GNN”的所有目标；它主要描述了普通 GNN 用于图分类时的标准做法。其做法是：先为图中所有节点生成 embeddings，再通过全局池化（如简单求和或作用于集合的神经网络）把这些节点 embeddings 合并起来做整图预测；这种全局池化会忽略图中可能存在的层次结构 [diffpool_2018]。

DiffPool 的目标不同：它是一个可微图池化模块，目标是以层次化、端到端方式学习图的层次表示 [diffpool_2018]。具体地，DiffPool 在每一层用 GNN 得到节点 embeddings，再根据这些 embeddings 学习节点到簇的 soft assignment，把节点聚类并粗化图，然后在粗化图上继续运行下一层 GNN；该过程重复多层，最终用输出表示进行整图分类 [diffpool_2018]。因此，DiffPool 不只是生成节点级 embeddings，而是学习如何逐层聚类/粗化节点，构建多层的图级层次表示 [diffpool_2018]。

关键差别可概括为：普通 GNN 在图分类中的直接节点级步骤是“生成所有节点 embeddings，再做全局池化”；DiffPool 则进一步学习每层的可微软分配矩阵，将节点映射到簇并逐步 coarsen 图，从而生成层次表示 [diffpool_2018]。DiffPool 还用 GNN 同时提取“有利于图分类的节点 embeddings”和“有利于层次池化的节点 embeddings” [diffpool_2018]。

evidence.content:
We develop a graph analogue of the spatial pooling operation in CNNs [ 24], which allows for deep CNN architectures to iteratively operate on coarser and coarser representations of an image. The challenge in the GNN setting—compared to standard CNNs—is that graphs contain no natural notion of spatial locality, i.e., one cannot simply pool together all nodes in a “ m×m patch” on a graph, because the complex topological structure of graphs precludes any straightforward,
deterministic definition of a “patch”. Moreover, unlike image data, graph data sets often contain graphs with varying numbers of nodes and edges, which makes defining a general graph pooling operator even more challenging. In order to solve the above challenges, we require a model that learns how to cluster together nodes to build a hierarchical multi-layer scaffold on top of the underlying graph. Our approach DIFFPOOL learns a differentiable soft assignment at each layer of a deep GNN, mapping nodes to a set of clusters based on their learned embeddings. In this framework, we generate deep GNNs by “stacking” GNN layers in a hierarchical fashion (Figure 1): the input nodes at the layer l GNN module correspond to the clusters learned at the layer l− 1 GNN module. Thus, each layer of DIFFPOOL coarsens the input graph more and more, and DIFFPOOL is able to generate a hierarchical representation of any input graph after training. We show that DIFFPOOL can be combined with various GNN approaches, resulting in an average 7% gain in accuracy and a new state of the art on four out of five benchmark graph classification tasks. Finally, we show thatDIFFPOOL can learn interpretable hierarchical clusters that correspond to well-defined communities in the input graphs.

question: GAT 和 GraphSAGE 在邻域聚合上的主要区别是什么？
answer:
主要区别在邻域聚合的加权方式与聚合流程：

- **GAT** 在邻域聚合中使用**注意力机制**，对同一邻域内不同邻居分配**不同权重**；与之对比的 **Const-GAT** 使用常数注意力，即给每个邻居相同重要性、类似 GCN 的聚合方式 [gat_2018]。GAT 的改进被归因于能够观察整个邻域并对不同邻居赋予不同权重 [gat_2018]。
- **GraphSAGE** 通过可替换的 **AGGREGATE** 函数聚合邻居表示，支持多种聚合器架构；聚合后，将邻域聚合向量与节点当前表示**拼接**，再经全连接层和非线性激活得到下一层表示 [graphsage_2017]。其聚合器变体包括 mean、LSTM、pool、GCN-like 等；在 PPI 上，LSTM- 和 pooling-based 聚合器优于 mean- 和 GCN-based 聚合器 [graphsage_2017]。
- GraphSAGE 在其实验设置中还使用固定大小的邻域采样（如 \(K=2, S_1=25, S_2=10\)）[graphsage_2017]，而 GAT 的收益与聚合整个邻域相关 [gat_2018]。

因此，核心区别是：**GAT 用 attention 对同一邻域内不同邻居做差异化加权；GraphSAGE 用可配置的邻居聚合器聚合邻居，并与节点自身表示拼接，且实验中使用邻域采样** [gat_2018][graphsage_2017]。

In this paper we have introduced personalized propagation of neural predictions (PPNP) and its fast approximation, APPNP. We derived this model by considering the relationship between GCN and
PageRank and extending it to personalized PageRank. This simple model decouples prediction and propagation and solves the limited range problem inherent in many message passing models without introducing any additional parameters. It uses the information from a large, adjustable (via the teleport probabilityα) neighborhood for classifying each node. The model is computationally effi-cient and outperforms several state-of-the-art methods for semi-supervised classification on multiple graphs in the most thorough study which has been done for GCN-like models so far.
For future work it would be interesting to combine PPNP with more complex neural networks used e.g. in computer vision or natural language processing. Furthermore, faster or incremental approx-imations of personalized PageRank (Bahmani et al., 2010; 2011; Lofgren et al., 2014) and more sophisticated propagation schemes would also benefit the method.

question: 从“随机游走共现”到“显式邻域消息传播”，DeepWalk 与 GCN 的核心机制如何衔接和区分？
answer:
证据支持的衔接是：两者都与图上随机游走/传播有关，但 DeepWalk 把随机游走当作生成共现序列的采样机制，GCN 则以显式邻域消息传播/聚合为核心。

- DeepWalk 将图顶点表示学习建模为“短随机游走流”，用神经语言模型处理这些随机游走，学习能捕捉邻域相似性和社区成员的潜在表示 [deepwalk_2014]。
- DeepWalk 的目标函数可写成基于节点对集合的平滑函数，其中节点表示 \(z_i\) 是直接优化（embedding look-up）的表示；DeepWalk 也等价于 node2vec 在 \(p=q=1\) 时的模型 [graphsage_2017]。
- GCN 属于 message passing 算法，核心是邻域聚合；但这类邻域聚合本质上是 Laplacian smoothing，层数过多会导致 oversmoothing，并且通常只利用非常有限的邻域 [appnp_2019]。
- GCN 与随机游走存在分析上的衔接：随层数增加，GCN 会收敛到某个随机游走的极限分布；该极限分布是整图属性，不考虑随机游走的起始根节点，因此不适合描述根节点邻域，GCN 在层数很多时性能会下降 [appnp_2019]。
- 因此，DeepWalk 中的随机游走是“输入共现序列生成器”，用于直接优化节点 embedding [deepwalk_2014][graphsage_2017]；GCN 中的随机游走更多是分析多层邻域传播极限的工具，实际机制是显式邻域聚合/消息传播 [appnp_2019]。
- 在效果差异上，证据指出 DeepWalk 收敛较慢，在归纳任务上表现差；在传导式固定图上大量训练时更有竞争力，但 GCN-based 方法即使在理论上有助于 DeepWalk 的传导式链接预测中也持续优于 DeepWalk [graphsage_2017]。
- 给定证据中，GCN 与 DeepWalk 仅被标记为 RELATED_TO [gcn_2017]，这本身不提供逐层公式或目标等价证明。

证据不足之处：无法从给定材料推出 DeepWalk 的 skip-gram/共现目标与 GCN 的逐层消息传播算子之间的精确数学等价或逐项对应；只能确认“随机游走极限”提供了分析衔接，而“显式邻域聚合”是其机制区别 [appnp_2019][gcn_2017]。

In this paper we introduce deep learning (unsupervised
feature learning) [2] techniques, which have proven success-ful in natural language processing, into network analysis for the first time. We develop an algorithm ( DeepWalk) that learns social representations of a graph’s vertices, by modeling a stream of short random walks. Social representations are latent features of the vertices that capture neighborhood similarity and community membership. These latent representations encode social relations in a continuous vector space with a relatively small number of dimensions. DeepWalk generalizes neural language models to process a
special language composed of a set of randomly-generated

question: GAT 为什么使用 multi-head attention？
answer:
依据给定证据，**无法确定 GAT 为什么使用 multi-head attention**：证据没有直接给出采用 multi-head attention 的设计动机或理论原因 [gat_2018]。

证据仅能支持以下事实：

- GAT 确实使用 multi-head attention [gat_2018]。
- 应用 multi-head attention 会使存储和参数需求乘以 K，但各个 head 的计算完全独立，并且可以并行化 [gat_2018]。
- 在实验中，GAT 的多头配置包括：转导任务第一层使用 K=8 个 attention heads，每个 head 计算 F′=8 个特征，共 64 个特征；第二层分类使用单个 attention head [gat_2018]。Pubmed 使用 K=8 个输出 attention heads [gat_2018]。归纳任务前两层各使用 K=4 个 attention heads，每个 head 计算 256 个特征，共 1024 个特征；最后一层使用 K=6 个 attention heads，每个 head 计算 121 个特征，并对其取平均 [gat_2018]。
- 注意力机制整体允许对同一邻域内不同节点赋予不同重要性，从而提升模型容量，并可能带来可解释性收益；但这并不等同于 multi-head attention 的采用原因 [gat_2018]。
- 与 Const-GAT 的对比表明，能够给不同邻居分配不同权重具有实际收益；这同样不是专门解释 multi-head attention 的原因 [gat_2018]。

因此，若问题是“GAT 为什么使用 multi-head attention”，给定证据不足以回答；只能确认 GAT 使用了 multi-head attention、其计算可并行、存储和参数随 K 倍增，以及实验中的多头配置 [gat_2018]。

Moreover, extending the method to perform graph classification instead of node classification would also be relevant from the application perspective. In this paper, we propose a novel GCN training algorithm by

We find that the efficiency of a mini-batch algorithm can be characterized by the notion of “embedding utilization”, which is proportional to the number of links between nodes in one batch or within-batch links. This finding mo-tivates us to design the batches using graph clustering algorithms that aims to construct partitions of nodes so that there are more graph links between nodes in the same partition than nodes in different partitions. Based on the graph clustering idea, we proposed
Cluster-GCN, an algorithm to design the batches based on efficient graph clustering algorithms (e.g., METIS [ 8]). We take this idea further by proposing a stochastic multi-clustering framework to improve the convergence of Cluster-GCN. Our strategy leads to huge memory and computational benefits. evidence.content:
Graph convolutional network (GCN) has been successfully applied to many graph-based applications; however, training a large-scale
GCN remains challenging. Current SGD-based algorithms suffer from either a high computational cost that exponentially grows with number of GCN layers, or a large space requirement for keep-ing the entire graph and the embedding of each node in memory. In this paper, we propose Cluster-GCN, a novel GCN algorithm that is suitable for SGD-based training by exploiting the graph clustering structure. Cluster-GCN works as the following: at each step, it samples a block of nodes that associate with a dense subgraph identified by a graph clustering algorithm, and restricts the neighborhood search within this subgraph. This simple but effective strategy leads to significantly improved memory and computational efficiency while being able to achieve comparable test accuracy with previous algorithms. To test the scalability of our algorithm, we create a new Amazon2M data with 2 million nodes and 61 million edges which is more than 5 times larger than the previous largest publicly available dataset (Reddit). For training a 3-layer GCN on this data,
Cluster-GCN is faster than the previous state-of-the-art VR-GCN
(1523 seconds vs 1961 seconds) and using much less memory (2.2GB vs 11.2GB). Furthermore, for training 4 layer GCN on this data, our algorithm can finish in around 36 minutes while all the existing
GCN training algorithms fail to train due to the out-of-memory issue.

APPNP 中，神经网络的预测矩阵 \(H=f_\theta(X)\) 同时充当传播的**起点**和 **teleport set**：  
\[

其作用可概括为：

1. **保留初始预测、防止传播退化为全局 PageRank**：

2. **通过 teleport 概率 \(\alpha\) 控制邻域影响范围**：

answer:
APPNP/PPNP 解耦预测网络与传播网络，主要是为了：

- 传统消息传递只考虑几步范围内的节点，且可利用邻域大小很难扩展；解耦后可用个性化 PageRank 传播，利用大范围、可通过传送概率 \(\alpha\) 调节的邻域，甚至等价于无限多邻域聚合层，从而解决 limited range 问题 [appnp_2019]。
- 解耦使神经网络深度完全独立于传播算法，传播范围不再受经典消息传递层数限制 [appnp_2019]。

- 该设计不引入额外参数，并保持计算高效 [appnp_2019]。

Neural message passing algorithms for semi-supervised classification on graphs have recently achieved great success. However, for classifying a node these methods only consider nodes that are a few propagation steps away and the size of this utilized neighborhood is hard to extend. We utilize this propagation procedure to construct a simple model, personalized propagation of neural predictions (PPNP), and its fast approximation, APPNP. Our model’s training time is on par or faster and its number of parameters on par or lower than previous models.
It leverages a large, adjustable neighborhood for classification and can be easily combined with any neural network. We show that this model outperforms several recently proposed methods for semi-supervised classification in the most thorough study done so far for GCN-like models. Our implementation is available online. 1

In this paper we have introduced personalized propagation of neural predictions (PPNP) and its fast approximation, APPNP. We derived this model by considering the relationship between GCN and
PageRank and extending it to personalized PageRank. This simple model decouples prediction and propagation and solves the limited range problem inherent in many message passing models without introducing any additional parameters. It uses the information from a large, adjustable (via the teleport probabilityα) neighborhood for classifying each node. The model is computationally effi-cient and outperforms several state-of-the-art methods for semi-supervised classification on multiple graphs in the most thorough study which has been done for GCN-like models so far.
For future work it would be interesting to combine PPNP with more complex neural networks used e.g. in computer vision or natural language processing. Furthermore, faster or incremental approx-imations of personalized PageRank (Bahmani et al., 2010; 2011; Lofgren et al., 2014) and more sophisticated propagation schemes would also benefit the method.

question: GAT 与 GIN 分别更强调哪种聚合能力？
answer:
根据给定证据：

- **GAT 更强调“注意力加权聚合”能力**：即在同一邻域内对不同邻居分配不同权重，而不是像 GCN 那样使用恒定/类 GCN 聚合。证据指出，GAT 优于 Const-GAT，直接说明“能够对不同邻居赋予不同权重”的重要性 [gat_2018]。  
- **GIN 更强调“求和聚合（sum aggregation）”能力**：GIN 使用 Sum–MLP 聚合，并且证据表明 sum-aggregation GNNs 能准确捕捉图结构，而 mean-aggregation GNNs 往往无法捕捉未标注图的结构，表现甚至不如随机猜测 [gin_2019]。GIN 还比较了用 mean 或 max-pooling 替换 sum 的较弱 GNN 变体 [gin_2019]。

因此：**GAT 侧重基于注意力的邻居差异化加权聚合 [gat_2018]；GIN 侧重基于 sum 聚合（配合 MLP）的图结构表达能力 [gin_2019]。**

question: 哪个核心模型既能通过邻居采样控制计算量，又能把学到的聚合器用于训练时未见节点？
answer:
严格依据给定证据，**无法确认有单一核心模型同时满足这两个条件**。

- 可训练聚合器的直接证据来自 **GraphSAGE**：其 pooling aggregator 是对邻居集合的对称且可训练聚合器，并提到 non-uniform samplers [graphsage_2017]。

When an attention mechanism is used to compute a representation of a single sequence,
it is commonly referred to as self-attention or intra-attention. Together with Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) or convolutions, self-attention has proven to be useful for tasks such as machine reading (Cheng et al., 2016) and learning sentence representations (Lin et al., 2017). However,
Vaswani et al. (2017) showed that not only self-attention can improve a method based on RNNs or convolutions, but also that it is sufficient for constructing a powerful model obtainingstate-of-the-art performance on the machine translation task. Inspired by this recent work, we introduce an attention-based architecture to perform node classification of graph-structured data. The idea is to compute the hidden representations of each node in the graph, by attending over its neighbors, following aself-attention strategy. The attention architecture has several interesting properties: (1) the operation is efficient, since it is parallelizable across node-neighbor pairs; (2) it can be applied to graph nodes having different degrees by specifying arbitrary weights to the neighbors; and (3) the model is directly applicable to inductive learning problems,
including tasks where the model has to generalize to completely unseen graphs. We validate the proposed approach on four challenging benchmarks: Cora, Citeseer and Pubmed citation networks as well as an inductive protein-protein interactiondataset, achieving or matching state-of-the-art results that highlight the potential of attention-based models when dealing with arbitrarily structured graphs.

We develop a graph analogue of the spatial pooling operation in CNNs [ 24], which allows for deep CNN architectures to iteratively operate on coarser and coarser representations of an image. The challenge in the GNN setting—compared to standard CNNs—is that graphs contain no natural notion of spatial locality, i.e., one cannot simply pool together all nodes in a “ m×m patch” on a graph, because the complex topological structure of graphs precludes any straightforward,
deterministic definition of a “patch”. Moreover, unlike image data, graph data sets often contain graphs with varying numbers of nodes and edges, which makes defining a general graph pooling operator even more challenging. In order to solve the above challenges, we require a model that learns how to cluster together nodes to build a hierarchical multi-layer scaffold on top of the underlying graph. Our approach DIFFPOOL learns a differentiable soft assignment at each layer of a deep GNN, mapping nodes to a set of clusters based on their learned embeddings. In this framework, we generate deep GNNs by “stacking” GNN layers in a hierarchical fashion (Figure 1): the input nodes at the layer l GNN module correspond to the clusters learned at the layer l− 1 GNN module. Thus, each layer of DIFFPOOL coarsens the input graph more and more, and DIFFPOOL is able to generate a hierarchical representation of any input graph after training. We show that DIFFPOOL can be combined with various GNN approaches, resulting in an average 7% gain in accuracy and a new state of the art on four out of five benchmark graph classification tasks. Finally, we show thatDIFFPOOL can learn interpretable hierarchical clusters that correspond to well-defined communities in the input graphs.
